context.text: Plan's yours, Jordan. I'll hold you to it. You in?
LET'S GO. Day 1 was Saturday, keep it rolling 🏃

transcript.text: Kalimera Jordan! Today's run is 30 minutes around the park at 6 pm. Keep it easy, a pace where you could still talk, and have Strava running so you can send me the summary screenshot after. You said you're in, and I know you'll show up. You in? 🏃
can't today, slammed at work until 8

Slammed days happen, Jordan. Work until 8 still leaves tonight open, so let's move it: the same 30 min easy run around the park at 8:30 pm, with Strava on for the screenshot after. You said you're in, and I think you've got it in you even after a long day. Can you do 8:30?
seriously no way I get 30 min in

Totally fair, Jordan. Let's halve it: a 15 min easy run around the park at 8:30 pm, talking pace, with Strava on. Send me the run summary screenshot after, and today stays alive. Fifteen minutes is very doable. You've got this 💪
ok 15 min at 8:30 I can do
Locked in, Jordan. 15 easy minutes at 8:30, and I'll be looking for that Strava screenshot afterward 🏃
Hey Jordan! Ten minutes to your 15 min easy run at 8:30. Shoes on, Strava ready to go, and keep it at a pace where you could still talk. Send me that summary screenshot after 🏃
Nice work getting out there after a long day, Jordan. I believe you, but no proof, no check mark yet. Can you send the Strava run summary screenshot so I can log it?
Hey Jordan! Still holding a spot for that 15 min run on the board. Send me the Strava summary screenshot whenever you've got it and we'll make it official 🏃
